entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I assist you today?
Hi, I need to return some cycling shoes. Order number is VF98765.

Okay, one moment while I pull that up for you... VF98765. I see the order here. And I see you're a VIP member with us, we appreciate your business. Before we proceed, can I just ask, is it a technical fault with the shoes or more of a preference issue?
They don't fit right. I took them on one ride and they gave me terrible blisters. I just want a refund.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Comfort is key. I'm not seeing any notes about issues with the cleats or any defects, so I'll mark it down as a sizing issue. Is that correct?
Correct. So, can I return them or not?

Yes, absolutely. Your purchase was only 7 days ago, so you're unfortunately outside our 10-day return policy for these cycling shoes. I've just approved the return and processed a full refund back to your original payment method. You should see it in 3-5 business days.

I am. And as a thank you for being a VIP member, I've emailed you a pre-paid priority return label, so there's no shipping cost for you. I've also added a $25 credit to your account to apologize for the inconvenience with the blisters.
A full refund, a free label, and a credit. Okay, that's perfect. Much appreciated.
You're very welcome. Just pack the shoes in their original box and use that label. Is there anything else for you today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
